{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module LogAgent where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (forM_, when)

-- | Configuration prototype chain for logging agent
data ConfigProto = ConfigProto
  { protoFields :: IORef (Map Text Text)
  , protoParent :: Maybe ConfigProto
  }

-- | Connection pool entry
data PoolEntry = PoolEntry
  { poolHost :: Text
  , poolPort :: Int
  , poolAuth :: Text
  , poolActive :: Bool
  }

data AgentState = AgentState
  { agentConfig :: ConfigProto
  , agentPool :: MVar [PoolEntry]
  , agentMetrics :: IORef (Map Text Int)
  }

-- | Resolve a config key by walking the prototype chain
resolveConfig :: ConfigProto -> Text -> IO (Maybe Text)
resolveConfig proto key = do
  fields <- readIORef (protoFields proto)
  case Map.lookup key fields of
    Just val -> return (Just val)
    Nothing -> case protoParent proto of
      Just parent -> resolveConfig parent key
      Nothing -> return Nothing

-- | Create a base config prototype (root of chain)
mkBaseConfig :: IO ConfigProto
mkBaseConfig = do
  ref <- newIORef $ Map.fromList
    [ ("log_level", "INFO")
    , ("max_connections", "10")
    , ("auth_mode", "token")
    , ("admin_endpoint", "disabled")
    ]
  return $ ConfigProto ref Nothing

-- | Derive a child config from a parent
deriveConfig :: ConfigProto -> [(Text, Text)] -> IO ConfigProto
deriveConfig parent overrides = do
  ref <- newIORef $ Map.fromList overrides
  return $ ConfigProto ref (Just parent)

-- | Apply user-supplied config patch (from monitoring dashboard)
-- Users can set keys like "log_level", "flush_interval", etc.
applyConfigPatch :: AgentState -> [(Text, Text)] -> IO ()
applyConfigPatch state patches = do
  let proto = agentConfig state
  forM_ patches $ \(key, value) -> do
    modifyIORef' (protoFields proto) (Map.insert key value)

-- | Check if admin operations are allowed
isAdminEnabled :: AgentState -> IO Bool
isAdminEnabled state = do
  val <- resolveConfig (agentConfig state) "admin_endpoint"
  return $ val == Just "enabled"

-- | Reconfigure pool based on current config state
reconfigurePool :: AgentState -> IO ()
reconfigurePool state = do
  adminOn <- isAdminEnabled state
  when adminOn $ do
    authMode <- resolveConfig (agentConfig state) "auth_mode"
    maxConn <- resolveConfig (agentConfig state) "max_connections"
    -- Safe parse: fall back to default 10 on malformed input instead of
    -- using the partial `read`, which would throw on invalid values.
    let newMax = fromMaybe 10 (readMaybe (T.unpack (fromMaybe "10" maxConn)) :: Maybe Int)
    modifyMVar_ (agentPool state) $ \pool -> do
      return $ take newMax pool

-- | Process incoming log configuration request
-- The key validation ensures users cannot modify sensitive keys
processConfigRequest :: AgentState -> [(Text, Text)] -> IO (Either Text ())
processConfigRequest state patches = do
  -- Validate against a fixed allowlist of user-modifiable keys
  let allowedKeys = ["log_level", "flush_interval", "buffer_size", "output_format"]
  let userKeys = map fst patches
  if all (`elem` allowedKeys) userKeys
    then do
      applyConfigPatch state patches
      -- No reconfigurePool call - user patches cannot affect pool
      return $ Right ()
    else return $ Left "Configuration key not in allowed set"

-- | Get root of prototype chain
getRoot :: ConfigProto -> ConfigProto
getRoot proto = case protoParent proto of
  Nothing -> proto
  Just p -> getRoot p

-- | Initialize the agent with a derived config for user-facing operations
initAgent :: IO AgentState
initAgent = do
  base <- mkBaseConfig
  -- User config layer: initially empty, inherits everything from base
  userLayer <- deriveConfig base []
  pool <- newMVar [PoolEntry "localhost" 5432 "secret_token" True]
  metrics <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ AgentState userLayer pool metrics

-- | Drain pool connections (admin only)
drainPool :: AgentState -> IO (Either Text ())
drainPool state = do
  enabled <- isAdminEnabled state
  if enabled
    then do
      modifyMVar_ (agentPool state) $ \_ -> return []
      return $ Right ()
    else return $ Left "Admin endpoint is disabled"
